note: One golden per graphics card (ADR 0008's update of 2026-10-03; register decisions 287-299; the mutants are decision 298's). Judged three ways: the folder name by test_golden_path, against hand-written strings; the application's --golden-dir path by the probe tests, which render `clear` with the mutant -- probe_clear_golden against this card's golden, probe_golden_no_card against a directory with no card's folder, whose expected card name RunProbe.cmake builds from the sidecar rather than from the application's message; and the guard on --accept-golden by its self-test. No survivor is declared.
